title: Nursing Homes Data Dashboard | NHSN | CDC
content: Nursing Home Data Dashboard Print Updated May 28, 2026 Minus Related Pages On This Page Overview Nursing Home Residents: Vaccination, Hospitalizations, Cases Nursing Home Healthcare Personnel: Vaccination Overview Nursing homes report COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) data weekly to CDC’s National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN), including vaccination, cases, and hospitalizations among residents. Nursing homes also report COVID-19 vaccination data among healthcare personnel (HCP) to NHSN monthly. This page displays data among residents and HCP of CMS-certified nursing homes. These national and state-level summaries represent data from approximately 15,000 nursing homes that report to NHSN. Additional information and resources about this surveillance can be found here: Long-Term Care Respiratory Pathogens . This data dashboard is updated weekly on Thursdays at 8:00 AM. Top of Page Vaccination Coverage among Nursing Home Residents Weekly cumulative percent of nursing home residents vaccinated COVID-19 vaccine, the seasonal influenza vaccine, and RSV vaccine. Preliminary data are shaded in gray. The 2025–2026 flu season is shown here as beginning in October, when vaccinations are typically first available. Influenza vaccine: percent of residents vaccinated with 2024-25/2025-26 seasonal influenza vaccine. RSV vaccine: percent of residents vaccinated with RSV vaccine. COVID-19 vaccine: percent of residents up to date with COVID-19 vaccines. The NHSN surveillance definition [PDF – 1MB] definition of up to date with COVID-19 vaccines is updated quarterly to incorporate vaccine guidance changes. For Quarter 4 of 2025 (September 29–December 28, 2025), facilities reported “up to date” COVID-19 vaccination status in the manner most meaningful with their infection prevention priorities and policies. Top of Page Case Rates per 100,000 Residents Weekly respiratory viral cases per 100,000 residents from CDC’s National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). Preliminary data are shaded in gray. Influenza and RSV data collection became required on January 1, 2025. Residents who tested positive during the week of data collection. Additional details found here [PDF – 2MB] Top of Page Hospitalization Rates per 100,000 Nursing Home Residents Weekly hospitalizations with a positive respiratory viral test per 100,000 residents from CDC’s National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). Preliminary data are shaded in gray. Influenza and RSV data collection became required on January 1, 2025. Residents hospitalized during the week of data collection, who tested positive for a respiratory pathogen in the 10 days prior to hospitalization. Additional details found here [PDF – 2MB] Top of Page Nursing Home Healthcare Personnel: COVID-19 Vaccination Weekly cumulative percent of nursing home healthcare personnel vaccinated with COVID-19 vaccine. COVID-19 vaccine: percent of healthcare personnel with COVID-19 vaccines. The NHSN surveillance definition [PDF – 1 MB] with COVID-19 vaccines is updated quarterly to incorporate vaccine guidance changes. Nursing homes are required to report healthcare personnel COVID-19 vaccination data 1 week per month, and data are due quarterly, approximately 4 months after the last week of a quarter.
